An '''airfoil''' was a stationary<ref name="SWS" /> or moveable flight component on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> or [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> [[Delaya-class courier|''Delaya''-class couriers]] were equipped with retractable airfoils,<ref name="TOTJC" /> as were [[sling racer]]s.<ref name="SotEPG" /> The [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]] was built around a primary airfoil that mounted the craft's main weapons pod.<ref name="SWS" />
